steps.text: Bring a rope, a shovel, a pick and destroy field runes. You need a partner for the chest.
steps.source: Required Equipment: Rope, Shovel, Pick, at least one Destroy Field Rune. You will now need someone to help you, a partner.

steps.text: In the Plains of Havoc, use your shovel on the hidden hole and go down.
steps.source: Go into the Plains of Havoc and head down a hidden hole (Mapper Coords 128.7, 126.11, 7).

steps.text: Fight the dragon and go down the ramp.
steps.source: On the 1st level down, you will fight a single Dragon. Proceed down the ramp.

steps.text: Two dragons (block one in the narrow passage) and down the ramp again.
steps.source: On the 2nd level down, 2 Dragons are present, but it is possible to fight them one at a time if you block one into the narrow passageway. Go down the ramp again.

steps.text: Go south through the corridor into the treasure room: dragons and 2 dragon lords. Lure them into the corridor one at a time.
steps.source: The 3rd level down has a corridor heading south, followed by an open room with many treasures, as well as 2 Dragon Lords and several Dragons. Kill them with caution, using the corridor to lure them one at a time.

steps.text: Use your pick on the spot marked X on the wiki map and go down: a fire devil and fire fields. Use a destroy field rune on the fire field with a body under it: Krendorak's corpse, with a bag holding the ornamented shield, a spike sword, a dragon necklace, a might ring, a crystal key and his journal. The room below isn't on the 7.1 map. Rope back up to the treasure room.
steps.source: Use a pick on the X marked on the map. Down the hole there is a Fire Devil and a number of Fire Fields. Pass them and use a Destroy Field Rune on the Fire Field with a body sticking out underneath of it. In the body you will find a Brown Bag containing the Ornamented Shield along with some other items. Rope yourself back up the hole to the main room.

steps.text: Your partner stands here, south-west of the fire field in the north-west corner: the stalagmites in the south-west corner disappear while they stay.
steps.source: To remove these stalagmites, have your partner stand on the spot directly southwest of the fire field in the northwest corner of the room.

steps.text: Walk past where the stalagmites were.
steps.source: You will see Stalagmites in the southwest corner blocking the way to a rope hole. Once the stalagmites have been removed, you can walk behind them.

steps.text: The chest behind the stalagmites: a time ring, a lyre, a spellbook, a garlic necklace and 5 platinum coins in a bag (the chest isn't on the 7.1 map; this is its 7.6 spot).
steps.source: Open the Chest (Quest), which contains a Red Bag with a Time Ring and some other items.
